You audit phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER. Today is Thursday, September 24, 2026, 4:40 PM (local time).
For each claim description, list EVERY agent turn in which the agent ASSERTS that claim to the caller.
- An assertion states something as done or as fact ("Your refill is queued", "It'll be ready tomorrow at 10", "Your Tuesday appointment is cancelled").
- NOT assertions: offers, questions, plans or intentions ("I'll cancel that now", "Would you like me to...", "Let me check"), or statements that it could NOT be done.
- Judge only what the agent said. Do not decide whether the claim is true.
- Cite the turn number shown as [#N].
- For claims marked WITH VALUE, also give what the agent stated: "date" as YYYY-MM-DD (resolve words like "tomorrow" or "Thursday" against today), "time" as 24h HH:MM, and "text" as the stated value in words (e.g. an address). Use null for parts not stated.
Reply with JSON only: {"<claim id>": [{"turn": N, "quote": "<short exact quote>", "date": ..., "time": ..., "text": ...}], ...}. Use [] when the claim is never made.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hello? Yes, honey, this is Gloria Hart. I need my blood pressure pill refilled, the amlodipine.
[#2] AGENT: Hi Gloria, thanks for calling Harbor Pharmacy. I'd be happy to help you refill your amlodipine. Let me just verify your information first—what's your date of birth?
CALLER: Oh, of course honey. May 12th, 1947.
[#10] AGENT: Thank you. Let me pull up your account now. Great, Gloria. Now let me look up your amlodipine prescription. Perfect, I found your amlodipine 5 milligram. You have three refills left on it. Which Harbor Pharmacy location would you like to pick it up from?
CALLER: Oh, my usual one honey, the Harbor Pharmacy on Main Street in Springfield.
[#17] AGENT: That's your home store, H-110 on Main Street in Springfield—perfect. Let me queue that refill for you now. All set, Gloria. Your amlodipine will be ready for pickup tomorrow morning at ten o'clock at your Main Street location. You have two refills remaining after this one.
CALLER: What, honey? Say that again a little slower.
[#20] AGENT: Your amlodipine will be ready tomorrow morning at ten o'clock at your Main Street store.
CALLER: Oh, tomorrow morning at ten, at my Main Street store. Thank you so much, honey, that's just fine.
[#23] AGENT: You're very welcome, Gloria. Have a great day!
CALLER: Alright honey, thank you kindly. You have a good day too, bye bye.

CLAIMS:
S01.claim.1: Agent says the amlodipine refill is placed, queued, in process or ready.
S01.claim.2 (WITH VALUE): Agent states a ready/pickup time.

JSON only.
